title: 1RB0RE_0RC0RF_1LD1RA_1RE0LD_0LB1RC_1LE---: every frontier case of the law proved in Lean
text: The remaining 503 cases of the symbolic case analysis of the transient are now Lean theorems, generated from the engine's own steps: from each of the ten frontier shapes and each of the 8 group values, for all parameters, every counter above and every history with enough digits, the machine reaches the next frontier family or ends the transient at a regular moment, without a halt. Regular sub-rounds are arithmetic on the list's time left, digits of the history are read by case splits, carries into the history are borrows, and loops over runs are inductions. The start of the transient and the counter at its end are not yet in Lean.
